Looking at a photograph a person said “I have no brother or sister but that man’s father is my father’s son”. At whose photograph was the person looking at?
questions.solution: Son of one’s father means the person himself. Therefore, that man is the son of the person.

questions.q:
Out of four friends A, B, C and D
    A and B play football and cricket
    B and C play cricket and hockey
    A and D play basket ball and football
    C and D play hockey and basket ball
    Then the friend who does not play hockey is
questions.solution:
From statement (II), Both B and C play hockey and from statement (IV), both C and D play hockey.
    Therefore, A do not play hockey
